name: high-frequency-all-optionals-lower-bounds
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. All seven OPTIONAL components of BasicVehicleContainerHighFrequency present (presence bits 1111111); every signed component at its lower bound (longitudinal, lateral and vertical acceleration -160, curvature -1023, yaw rate -32766, lane position -1 offTheRoad, steering wheel angle -511, tolling zone latitude -900000000 and longitude -1800000000, each written as 0 in its constrained whole number); accelerationControl brakePedalEngaged and cruiseControlEngaged (bits 1000010 = 66); cenDsrcTollingZone with its extension bit 0 and cenDsrcTollingZoneID 4242. 477 bits, padded to 60 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
